title: fix(plugin-list, app-shell): "Reset to view default" clears the stored list setting instead of copying the view into it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbKSY5upS6CYM6fGkDbsN2GK)_

Fixes #28948

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:列表「显示」里的「恢复视图默认设置」和排序面板里的「恢复视图默认排序」,现在清除读者自己存下的那部分偏好(行高、隐藏列、排序),不再把视图当时的默认值当成读者的选择写进去。条目清空后整条删除,⋯ 里的「重置视图」随之消失。
- **为什么改**:原来恢复默认会把旧默认值存成读者的选择,管理员之后修改视图的行高、隐藏列或排序,这位读者仍停在旧值上,⋯ 也一直显示「重置视图」。
- **风险与回滚**:只动 `ui/` 的 `plugin-list`(`ListView` 新增宿主属性 `onRestoreViewDefaults`,`viewDefaults` 多一个 `sort`)和 `app-shell`(对象页接上这两个属性,恢复时把对应部分置空)。不动 spec、服务端和元数据。读者主动的「不排序」(`sort: []`)和「显示全部列」(`hiddenFields: []`)照旧保存。不接新属性的宿主行为不变。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` 的 `resetDisplayToViewDefault` 与 `handleResetSort`;`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewListRenderer.tsx` 的 `restoreViewDefaults`;新测试 `ListView.restoreViewDefaults-28948.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.restoreViewDefaults-28948.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.userListState-12418.test.tsx`,应 2 个文件全部通过(6 + 32 个用例);或在 Console 线索列表改行高后点「恢复视图默认设置」,该用户的 `sys_user_preference` 条目里不再有 `rowHeight`。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**`@object-ui/plugin-list` — `ListView`**

- New host prop `onRestoreViewDefaults(parts)`, where `parts` is drawn from `'sort' | 'hiddenFields' | 'rowHeight'`. When a host wires it, the Display control's "Reset to view default" and the sort popover's "Reset to view default" call it with the parts they returned to the view's own, in one call, and no longer write the view's values through `onHiddenFieldsChange`, `schema.onDensityChange` or `onSortChange` for those parts. The list puts the view's sort and hidden fields back at once; the table density follows `schema.rowHeight` once the host's clear lays the view's own back there.
- `viewDefaults` gains `sort` (a pick of `ListViewSchema`'s `hiddenFields`, `rowHeight` and `sort`). The sort popover's reset compares against it (enabled state, whether it is drawn) and restores it. As with the other two members, a passed `viewDefaults` is the whole baseline: an absent `sort` means the view declares none.
- Without `onRestoreViewDefaults` (and without `viewDefaults`), both resets behave exactly as before. Layout, grouping, row color, row numbers, inline edit and the gallery card size reset as before in every case.

**`@object-ui/app-shell` — the object page's list**

- Hands `viewDefaults.sort` (the view's own sort, under the link's or user's stored sort that the `sort` rung lays over it) and wires `onRestoreViewDefaults` to `restoreViewDefaults`, which patches each named part to `null` on the user's list state (`listPrefs.patchView`). `patchViewPreference` already treats `null` as a clear and removes a view left with nothing, so "Reset view" disappears with the last part. A sort reset also takes the sort off the URL (`writeListUrlState({ sort: null })`).
- `ListPreferencesProvider`: docblock only — `ListViewPreferencePatch` now names the list's per-part reset as the second way back to the view's own.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.restoreViewDefaults-28948.test.tsx` (new, 6 cases): the Display reset names `hiddenFields` and calls no `onHiddenFieldsChange`; names `rowHeight`, calls no `onDensityChange`, and follows the host's re-rendered `schema.rowHeight`; both differ ⇒ one call naming both; the sort reset returns to `viewDefaults.sort` (server `$orderby` moves from the user's to the view's), names `sort`, calls no `onSortChange`; CONTROL: removing the last sort level still emits `onSortChange([])`; CONTROL: row numbers reset without naming anything.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.userListState-12418.test.tsx` — new describe at the host seam (real `ObjectView`, real `ListPreferencesProvider`, recorded list-state family), 6 cases: the list is wired and handed the view's sort; a Display reset leaves neither density nor hidden fields in the saved row; after it, a changed view `rowHeight` / `hiddenFields` reaches the user on the next open; a sort reset with nothing else stored saves `{}` and the ⋯ "Reset view" entry goes; after it, a changed view sort reaches the user; CONTROL: a deliberate `sort: []` and `hiddenFields: []` are saved and survive a reload. The three `viewDefaults` equality pins now include `sort`; the old "the list's reset writes through the doors" case is renamed to what it pins (a choice equal to the view's own is stored as a choice).

<details><summary>Ablation (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, source-resolved, no dist)</summary>

- Sort reset back to the door (`if (onRestoreViewDefaults) onRestoreViewDefaults(['sort']); else emitSortChange(restored);` to `emitSortChange(restored);`): 1 failed (the sort reset case), 5 passed. Restored, blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Density leg removed (the `else if (onRestoreViewDefaults)` branch dropped, so the density goes through `density.setMode`): 2 failed (the density case, the both-parts case), 4 passed. Restored, blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Host stores the view's values instead of clearing (`patch[part] = null` to the view's value per part): 4 failed in the host file (both "leaves nothing stored" cases and both "follows the view on the next open" cases), 28 passed. Restored, blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The sort popover's reset in the console used to return to the sort the list OPENED with (a link's sort, or the user's stored sort), per the `sort` rung's old comment. It now returns to the view's own sort, which is what its label says and what a reload shows once the stored sort is cleared; "Reset view" already did this.
- A display reset under `onRestoreViewDefaults` does not set the density locally; it waits for the host to clear `rowHeight`. A host wiring the prop must clear what it is named, which the docblock says.
- Not pinned: the URL `sort` param removal on a sort reset (the harness's `MemoryRouter` URL is not read by these tests).
- #28950 (the 已个性化 marker) builds on these reset paths and is out of scope here.

## Verification

All on the final head `eda72c06` (base `origin/main` `fed3a51b`), after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --filter='@object-ui/plugin-list^...'` plus formula, sdui-parser, lint and client (64 tasks, exit 0), under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

- The whole `packages/plugin-list/` vitest suite plus 16 app-shell / console / plugin-view test files that name the touched modules or props (`git grep -l` of `objectViewListRenderer`, `ListPreferencesProvider`, `viewDefaults`, `listPrefs`, `patchView`, `onHiddenFieldsChange`, `onDensityChange`, the two reset test ids), `--maxWorkers=2`: 196 files, 1907 tests passed. A declared narrowing for app-shell; CI's Test UI runs the rest.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-list run type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (the test programs included): exit 0.
- ESLint on the five changed tsx files: exit 0, 0 errors (existing warnings only).
- Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`): 35 of 35 run, each exit 0 (`check:type-check-debt` and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` under the lock; the latter 169 files passed, 2 skipped), including `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` and the PR-body gates with this body as `GITHUB_EVENT_PATH`. `--ran` reconciles 35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `check-partof-closing-keyword` with `PR_BODY`: exit 0. `ui` `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.
- `origin/main` moved to `ab085a04` since the base; none of its commits touch the five changed files, so no merge was taken before opening.
